# MCP schema weight (approx tokens, db.ApproxTokens)

Generated by TestSchemaWeight_Report (`-update-schema-weight`). #2003.
Weight = the tools/list entry a client receives (name + title +
description + inputSchema + annotations), chars/4 heuristic.

Default since v1.6 (#2005): toolset=core, style=lean. PINCHER_TOOLSET=full
+ PINCHER_SCHEMA_STYLE=rich restores the pre-v1.6 surface.

| full | lean | 34 | 7077 |
| core | rich | 11 | 9641 |
| core | lean | 11 | 3335 |

## Router-present surface (router-loop B5)

`models` + `route` join the advertisement only when a live pincher-router
is detected (in BOTH toolset modes — they ride with the core set). The
tables above ARE the absent state: zero delta against the pre-router
surface (plan §A6). The detected-state core+lean total is held to the
same budget gate (TestSchemaWeight_CoreLean_RouterPresent_UnderBudget).

| toolset | style | tools | total tokens |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| full | rich | 36 | 20070 |
| full | lean | 36 | 7498 |
| core | rich | 13 | 10683 |
| core | lean | 13 | 3756 |

| router tool | rich | lean |
|---|--:|--:|
| models | 425 | 169 |
| route | 617 | 252 |
